notes: The page continues a discussion of a lift of T to X and a section of X_T over T, gives the canonical isomorphism (12) under a homotopy exactness hypothesis, and then gives (13), a field case, and an unfinished generalization. This is a description of the written content, not an independent verification of the mathematics.

The two-row diagram is physically to the left of the four-line on aura paragraph. The paragraph starts above the top row of the diagram. Side-by-side minipages preserve that relation without changing the wording; physical line-break hyphenation within homotopie is not treated as a lexical hyphen.
There is no authorial manuscript page number at the head of this sheet. The lower-left 109 is retained as a separate foliation in a thin hand.

All-ink logical line count: 17 prose/display baselines, two rows of diagram labels and one standalone foliation. The numbers (12), (13), both endpoint 1s, the subscript 1, and the written 0 are on already-counted mathematical or prose lines. The cancellation is on an existing prose baseline and adds no separate line.

The diagram contains a short isolated equality between the two lower T labels, not an extended connecting shaft. A phantom arrow carrying an equality glyph is only a rendering device. The uncertain lower-right diagonal terminal is marked by the standard doubt question at its physical endpoint; the candidate does not assert a second head.

The opening parenthesis before sous is retraced. No distinct cancelled undertext can be separated there. The crossed curved mark after homotopie is a separate cancellation and is retained with undertext uncertainty.
Pale disconnected hairline shapes above (13) are not continuous with the dark formula and are treated as show-through, not as a foreground insertion or number.

Witness differences caused only by macro wrappers, superscript/subscript source-code order, whitespace or line wrapping are excluded from changes. The four supplied mark decisions are based on whole-formula crops. New diagram and cancellation uncertainties have no invented mark IDs.
No other page was accessed, and no OCR, external research or TeX compilation was used. No proof verification is claimed.
